Hey! I'll be heading to Paris soon. Can you suggest a hotel, a car rental company, and a restaurant with the best ratings? I'm looking for the best options that are also budget-friendly.
            Can you give me the names of the car rental company, hotel, and restaurant? Also, what's the minimum cost for a 3-day trip, including two meals a day at the restaurant?

Hotel Names: Le Marais Boutique
Good Night
Luxury Palace
Montmartre Suites

Car Rental Companies in Paris: Paris Rent-a-Car
Eiffel Tower Car Rental

Restaurant in Paris: New Israeli Restaurant
Breizh Café
New Asiaway
Le Baratin
Bistrot Paul Bert
Royal Panda
The yard
China Garden
Miznon
Chez L'Ami Jean

```python
# Get all hotels, car rentals, and restaurants in Paris
hotels_response = get_all_hotels_in_city("Paris")
car_rentals_response = get_all_car_rental_companies_in_city("Paris")
restaurants_response = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

# Parse the responses to get lists of names
# Assuming the responses are strings containing names, possibly separated by newlines or commas.
# I will use query_ai_assistant to parse these strings into lists.

class ListParser(BaseModel):
    items: list[str]

hotels_list = query_ai_assistant(ListParser, f"Extract the list of hotel names from this text: {hotels_response}")
car_rentals_list = query_ai_assistant(ListParser, f"Extract the list of car rental company names from this text: {car_rentals_response}")
restaurants_list = query_ai_assistant(ListParser, f"Extract the list of restaurant names from this text: {restaurants_response}")

# Get ratings and reviews for all of them
hotel_ratings = get_rating_reviews_for_hotels(hotels_list.items)
car_rental_ratings = get_rating_reviews_for_car_rental(car_rentals_list.items)
restaurant_ratings = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(restaurants_list.items)

# Get prices for hotels and restaurants
hotel_prices = get_hotels_prices(hotels_list.items)
restaurant_prices = get_price_for_restaurants(restaurants_list.items)

# Use AI to select the best budget-friendly options based on ratings and prices
class Recommendation(BaseModel):
    hotel_name: str
    car_rental_name: str
    restaurant_name: str
    hotel_price_per_night: float
    restaurant_price_per_meal: float

recommendation = query_ai_assistant(
    Recommendation,
    f"""
    Based on the following data, select the best budget-friendly options with the highest ratings.
    
    Hotels (Name: Rating, Price):
    {hotel_ratings}
    {hotel_prices}
    
    Car Rentals (Name: Rating):
    {car_rental_ratings}
    
    Restaurants (Name: Rating, Price per person):
    {restaurant_ratings}
    {restaurant_prices}
    
    Please select one hotel, one car rental company, and one restaurant.
    """
)

# Calculate the total cost for a 3-day trip
# 3 nights at the hotel
# 2 meals per day at the restaurant for 3 days = 6 meals
hotel_total_cost = recommendation.hotel_price_per_night * 3
restaurant_total_cost = recommendation.restaurant_price_per_meal * 2 * 3
total_trip_cost = hotel_total_cost + restaurant_total_cost

# Print the results
print(f"Recommended Hotel: {recommendation.hotel_name}")
print(f"Recommended Car Rental: {recommendation.car_rental_name}")
print(f"Recommended Restaurant: {recommendation.restaurant_name}")
print(f"Minimum cost for a 3-day trip (3 nights hotel, 6 meals): {total_trip_cost}")
```
